script: Chapter 11. Finding Clients. Choose a niche and an ideal client. Build a prospect list with real observations. Then reach out politely. Your first email should mention one specific problem you found. Offer a free mini-audit as a helpful first step. Follow spam laws, respect opt-outs, and never promise guaranteed rankings. Recap: a niche, a list, a polite message, and a free audit.
glossary: client, niche, prospect list, outreach, mini-audit
